# Paths a pull request from a fork may not change: CI, build and tooling that run with the
# repository's trust. One entry per line; an entry ending in "/" covers everything under it.
#
# Read from the BASE branch by .github/workflows/protected-paths.yml (so a fork cannot edit its way
# past it) and by tools/DerivedReport, which flags these paths as "CI and tooling touched" in the
# PR summary. Changing this list is itself a protected change.
.github/
.config/
scripts/
tools/
Directory.Build.props
Directory.Build.targets
Directory.Packages.props
global.json
nuget.config
NuGet.config
Parquet.SourceGenerator.slnx
